newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse closes in flat trade.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse closes in flat trade.

text.p: The Casablanca bourse closed on Tuesday with a drop in the value of main stocks, stockbrokers said.
The bourse all-share index fell 0.08 percent to close at 428.09 points.
"After a period during which all stocks benefited from a bullish market, the time is now one of readjustment," said Sanae Bennouna, analyst at Upline Securities.
He said traded volume on the official market jumped to 36.8 million dirhams ($4.2 million) from 19.2 million dirhams on Monday.
SNI, which controls stakes in more than 40 companies and has a capitalisation of 5.8 billion dirhams, lost two dirhams to close at 588 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce et de l'Industrie fell five dirhams to 324 dirhams.

Moroccan credit company Eqdom shed nine dirhams to close at 945 dirhams, despite the release of its half-year results for 1996 that showed a net profit of 76.3 million dirhams, compared with 53.4 million dirhams in the same period last year.

The best performer was Morocco's leading sugar company Cosumar which gained 11 dirhams to trade at 680 dirhams, after the publication of its provisional profits of 171.1 million dirhams in the first half of the year, more than triple those of the same period in 1995. ($1= 8.7 dirhams)
